paragraphs: Chana: Rav Acha bar Chana; Rav Chaga bar Chana. [Glosses: Chana. (a) Shabbat 97a, near the end: R. Chana sat and had difficulty. Maharshal writes that it should read “Rav Chisda had difficulty, and Rav Yosef said to him, ‘The Master ...’” I think it should be emended thus, since this is the reading in Tosafot, Shabbat, chapter 1, 4b, under “He threw, etc.” However, Rabbenu Tam reads “Rav Yosef sat and had difficulty; Rav Chisda said to him, ‘The Master ...’”—so too in the new Talmud editions. (b) Chullin 19a has Rav Chanan son of Rav Katina; Gittin 38a, near the end, has Chanina. It should read Chana; it was not corrected.]
